description: This instrumentation enables object pool metrics for Apache Commons Pool GenericObjectPool and GenericKeyedObjectPool instances. When Apache DBCP instrumentation is enabled, metrics for the GenericObjectPool backing an Apache DBCP BasicDataSource are excluded because the DBCP instrumentation already reports database connection pool metrics for it.
name: apache-commons-pool-2.0

metrics.description: The number of objects currently in the state described by the state attribute.
metrics.name: apache_commons_pool.object.count

metrics.description: The maximum number of idle objects allowed in the pool.
metrics.name: apache_commons_pool.object.idle.max

metrics.description: The minimum number of idle objects allowed in the pool.
metrics.name: apache_commons_pool.object.idle.min

metrics.description: The maximum number of objects allowed in the pool.
metrics.name: apache_commons_pool.object.max

metrics.description: The number of requests currently waiting for an object from the pool.
metrics.name: apache_commons_pool.object.pending_requests
